title: Wonderful and spectacular Santa Maria del Mar cathedral
text:
You should include the rooftop, it's cool
The view of the cathedral is impressive and the guide explained the history and everything related to the tour very well; don't miss going up to the rooftop to have a wonderful view of almost all of Barcelona, and at night it must be a very, very beautiful experience as they say here, very cool.
